Plot a Linkage Map with QTL Overlay (qtlAim)

Source: R/linkMap.qtlAim.R
linkMap.qtlAim.Rd

Plots the genetic linkage map for a "wgCross" object with detected QTL overlaid as coloured fills inside each chromosome bar. Flanking markers are annotated on the right; trait labels appear on the left.

Multiple qtlAim models can be overlaid by passing them as extra positional arguments, e.g.\ linkMap(qtl_yld, qtl_tgw, genObj = my_int), producing a multi-trait legend with automatic colour assignment.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'qtlAim'
linkMap(
  object,
  ...,
  genObj,
  chr,
  chr.dist,
  marker.names = "markers",
  flanking = TRUE,
  qtl.colour = "steelblue",
  marker.colour = "firebrick",
  trait.colour = qtl.colour,
  m.cex = 7,
  trait.labels = NULL,
  tick = FALSE,
  nrow = 1,
  row.chr = NULL
)

Arguments

object

A qtlAim object, or the first of several when multiple models are passed for a multi-trait overlay.

...

Additional qtlAim models (positional, unnamed) for multi-trait display, and/or named arguments passed through to linkMap.cross.

genObj

The "wgCross" object produced by primeCross used in the analysis.

chr

Optional character vector of chromosome names to display.

chr.dist

Optional named list with $start / $end elements restricting the displayed cM range per chromosome.

marker.names

"markers" (default), "dist", "none", or NULL.

flanking

Logical. If TRUE (default), only the QTL flanking markers are annotated on the right axis.

qtl.colour

Colour(s) for QTL fills. Recycled across traits in multi-model mode.

marker.colour

Colour for flanking marker labels.

trait.colour

Colour(s) for left-side trait labels. Defaults to qtl.colour.

m.cex

Text size (pt) for labels. Default 7.

trait.labels

Optional character vector of trait names (one per model). Defaults to the left-hand side of each model's fixed formula.

tick

Logical. Unused; retained for backward compatibility.

nrow

Integer or "auto". Number of facet rows. Default 1.

row.chr

Optional named list of character vectors for manual multi-row chromosome layout.

Value

A ggplot object.

See also

linkMap, linkMap.cross, linkMap.gwasAim, qtlAim

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Single model
linkMap(qtl.fit, genObj = genoRxK)

# Multi-trait overlay
linkMap(qtl.yld, qtl.tgw, genObj = genoRxK,
        trait.labels = c("Yield", "TGW"))
} # }
